sentences.en: The family mourned the tragic death of their young child.
sentences.zh: 这家人哀悼他们年幼的孩子悲惨离世。

sentences.en: My fingers are all inky from the tragic calligraphy accident.
sentences.zh: 我的手指因为书法事故沾满了墨水，真是个悲剧。

sentences.en: Sami had to break the tragic news to Layla's parents.
sentences.zh: 萨米不得不把这个悲惨的消息告诉莱拉的父母。

senses.zh: 悲惨的，悲剧性的；悲剧的，戏剧性的

mnemonic: 联想记忆：t+rag（破旧衣服）+ic→穿破旧衣服的→悲惨的
